Waived as multiplayer-only under the shared contract's explicit exclusion, not under an unreachability claim about ported content: the field is initialised True (PaelsEye.cs:21) and the only writer other than this hook is AfterSideTurnStart, which in single-player always takes the `participants.Contains(base.Owner.Creature)` branch and re-assigns True (lines 96-100).

AfterSideTurnStart.rationale: PaelsEye.cs:86-107 writes base.Status (presentation) and WasOwnerPartOfLastPlayerTurn (the multiplayer field waived on AfterObtained above). ShouldTakeExtraTurn.issue: Closed 2026-07-27: all three guards in this rollup are fixed. G1 -- `reset_for_combat` clears `used_this_combat` on every attach (sts2_rl/relics/paels_eye.py:27-29 = PaelsEye.cs:142-147). BeforeSideTurnEndEarly.maps_to: on_player_turn_end_early (sts2_rl/relics/paels_eye.py:61-78) -- the EARLY phase of the on_player_turn_end walk
BeforeSideTurnEndEarly.issue: Closed 2026-07-27: the exhaust has its real home. sts2_rl/relics/paels_eye.py:61-78 overrides `on_player_turn_end_early` -- the EARLY phase of HookSystem's on_player_turn_end walk (sts2_rl/hooks.py:36-38, 153-180) -- which is Hook.BeforeTurnEnd's second sub-slot (Hook.cs:1250), and it re-derives the same condition ShouldTakeExtraTurn uses, as PaelsEye.cs:118-128 does. WAS: the sim folded the exhaust into on_extra_turn, which fires AFTER the decision and INSTEAD of the turn-end pass.

AfterTakingExtraTurn.rationale: PaelsEye.cs:130-140 does Flash() + base.Status (presentation, waived as N4) and `UsedThisCombat = true`. The sim sets the same flag. The `player != base.Owner` bail (line 132) is structurally satisfied by the single-player CombatState. NOTE the collapse per PROMPT.md bug class 15: the sim maps TWO C# hooks (BeforeSideTurnEndEarly and AfterTakingExtraTurn) onto one method, and their C# guard sets are NOT identical -- the exhaust checks four conditions, the flag-set checks only ownership. Because the sim only ever calls on_extra_turn when should_take_extra_turn already returned True, the union it applies equals the exhaust's set, and the flag can only be set on a turn the exhaust also ran. So the collapse is lossless HERE; what is not lossless is the timing, which is G3.

AfterCombatEnd.issue: Closed 2026-07-27: the per-combat reset exists. `Relic.reset_for_combat` is declared on the base (sts2_rl/relics/base.py:177-190) and `Relic.attach` runs it every time the relic joins a new CombatState (sts2_rl/relics/base.py:192-195) -- one sim boundary standing in for the three C# spells it (AfterCombatEnd / BeforeCombatStart / AfterRoomEntered(CombatRoom)), and it also covers the hole AfterCombatEnd alone leaves when a fight ends inside play_card. sts2_rl/relics/paels_eye.py:27-29 clears `used_this_combat` (PaelsEye.cs:142-147; the base.Status half is presentation). WAS: nothing in the sim ever put the flag back, so the relic worked in the first combat of a run only.
